tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Signed-in only. Lists the signed-in user's saved brands so create_presentation can ground company and product facts with brand_id. Leaves brands and plan capacity untouched.

tools.name: export_presentation
tools.description: Signed-in only. Exports a finished presentation deck as a signed, expiring PowerPoint (pptx) or PDF (pdf) download link. Leaves the deck and plan capacity untouched.

tools.name: get_presentation
tools.description: Signed-in only. Reads a presentation deck's generation progress, review status, check findings, figure check, app link, and first-slide preview image when generation is complete. tools.name: create_presentation
tools.description: Signed-in only. Starts a presentation deck in the user's Gixo Lumen workspace from a brief or a public webpage URL, using licensed photos, charts and diagrams for pictures. Returns content_id and status in_progress right away; call get_presentation with content_id until status is ok.

tools.name: apply_presentation_edit
tools.description: Signed-in only. Applies user-approved slide changes from preview_presentation_edit to the presentation in Gixo Lumen. Same-slide rewrites and layout updates apply by default; slide inserts, deletes and moves apply when their operation_id is listed in operation_ids. Leaves plan AI allowance untouched

tools.name: preview_presentation_edit
tools.description: Signed-in only. Proposes slide edits to a saved Lumen presentation from your instruction and shows before-and-after text for user approval.
